title: Implement interval merging
instruction: Implement mergeIntervals(intervals) in src/intervals.mjs. Input is an array of [start, end] pairs of finite numbers with start <= end, in any order. Return a new array of merged, non-overlapping intervals sorted by start. Intervals that overlap or touch (end of one equals start of the next) are merged. Do not mutate the input or its pairs. Throw RangeError for a pair with start > end or non-finite numbers.
